_comment: Template, not a working config. qa/run-benchmark.sh renders it into a throwaway copy of
this directory under qa/work/ before every run, substituting __CONDUCTOR_DIR__ with the
conductor tree actually installed on the machine and __JOURNAL__ with a path inside that
throwaway copy. Nothing here is machine-specific, and a run never writes into the file
The hook set mirrors what tools/settings-json.py installs for real - deliberately,
including the test-run journal. A benchmark arm that differs from the deployed
configuration measures something nobody runs; that mistake has already been made twice
in this project. The journal writes no stdout and always exits 0, so it cannot change
measured behaviour; __JOURNAL__ keeps fixture runs out of the live journal, whose whole
purpose is evidence from real work.
